title: Campaigns
viewerReason: Viewers can't create or change campaigns. Ask a workspace admin to change your role.

gated.title: Read every channel of a campaign in one place
gated.body: Campaigns group the tagged variants of your links: their clicks on one page, a UTM builder with your defaults, and CSV export.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.body: A campaign groups the tagged variants of your links so you can read their clicks together.
empty.bodyViewer: Campaigns created in this workspace appear here.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.body: Its UTM variants are removed from {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}. The links themselves keep working. This can't be undone.

createPage.title: New campaign
createPage.description: Name it the way it should read as utm_campaign in your analytics. You'll tag links for it next.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Used as utm_campaign in the URLs you tag.
fields.renameHint: Saved variants switch to the new title. URLs you've already shared keep the old one, and their clicks stop counting here.

links.copied: Copied {count, plural, one {# short link} other {# short links}}, one per line
links.emptyTitle: No links in this campaign yet
links.emptyBody: A link joins when one of its UTM variants uses this campaign. Build one and save it as a variant.

builder.title: UTM builder
builder.description: Tag a short link for one channel. utm_campaign is always this campaign's title.
builder.notInCampaign: This link isn't in the campaign yet. Saving the variant adds it; until then its clicks don't count here.
builder.pickLinkFirst: Choose a link to build its URL.
builder.saveHint: Saving keeps the variant on the link: it shows in the link's UTM list and the campaign counts its clicks.
builder.duplicate: This variant is already saved on the link.

defaults.title: UTM defaults
defaults.description: Values the builder suggests for this campaign. They're saved in lowercase.

hints.sources: Where the traffic comes from, like newsletter or instagram.
hints.mediums: The kind of channel, like email or social.
hints.contents: What tells links in the same place apart, like header or footer.

placeholders.sources: Type a source and press Enter
placeholders.mediums: Type a medium and press Enter
placeholders.terms: Type a term and press Enter
placeholders.contents: Type a value and press Enter

errors.titleTaken: Another campaign already has this title.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this workspace.
errors.notFound: This campaign or link no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are too long or not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Shortn. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
